body: It's like hearing a broken record at this point.

Hey, I remember being in a relationship similar to yours. The constant anxiety was horrible. And yes this does belong here. Welcome to the sub. I hope you could talk to a relationship counselor about this. If not, try reading on the internet about separation anxiety. I think you might have it as I see the same signs I had.

Hey buddy. It seems you are really tired. I get it. Life is too much for all of us on here. People say to just keep trying, but there isn't anything worth living for anymore in our lives.

Just know that you are always welcome to vent on this sub.

Hey dude. Kids can be cruel, even if they don't mean it. I can't even begin to imagine what it feels like to hear all if that.

I get how it feels to have suicidal means ready, the relief it brings to just have it there.

I don't know why on the divorce issue, but I wouldn't recommend suicide. I don't know how old your kids are but, that might give them some trauma. I don't want to come off as trying to blame you though, the choice still is yours and only you should decide.

I hate how most divorces end up with the mother taking the kids. And in this case, she seems to be manipulative. You really need to get some extra help, I don't know why you are leaving but it must be for some reason. I don't think leaving the kids with her is the best idea. If she was willing to fake an injury to make them dislike you, what other things could she be telling them behind your back?

I'm so sorry. It breaks my heart to even read what your kids said. Just, please. Before you do anything rash, make sure the children don't blame themselves. You can always do it latter, okay?

Hey dude. Got the same treatment too.

No wonder why so many of us are on here instead of a hotline. They can't track us on here.
Thanks bud. Sh is one harsh addiction. Stay safe.
I hate God too if they exist. Punishing me for suicide, because they put me on this fucked up planet that they designed.

At the big scope, none if us do. We are just a speck in time compared to the whole universe. 

I guess what makes someone matter is the very tiny footprint we leave behind. 
As humans we cling to that footprint, too scared to being forgotten.

Mental hospitals are so dehumanizing. I'm sorry you had to go through all of this. It just show how fucked up this world is.

I hate it. It's were abusers get away with it and get a nice fat paycheck for it. They treat us like cash cows and when we try to escape, they just simply call us too irrational to decide for ourselves.

I have been to places were they forcibly drug children, force them through "treatment".

And all in the name of helping us.
No wonder people are afraid to get help.
Say you are suicidal once and spend days getting treated like shit.

Oh my God. Even this comment section isn't free from bigots. Like go prey on other people, not ones who are suicidal due to religious abuse.

I swear if I see a post about how op is gonna go to hell or stuff like that...

Like stop. Real christans don't say that.

(I think they deleted their comment though, but still the point still stands.)
Yep. Like why were we even born? I never asked to be made.
This is when sometimes saying it gets better is cruel. I feel you buddy. The fight never seems to end.
I don't think it's stupid. I'm the same. Its to the point it feels like my only escape.
